description: This file implements hostname utility functions for the quiche project, including hostname canonicalization, validation of SNI, and hostname normalization.

classes.name: QuicheHostnameUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing hostname validation and normalization functions.

methods.name: IsValidSNI
methods.description: Validates if the given SNI hostname is compliant and not an IP address.

methods.name: NormalizeHostname
methods.description: Returns a normalized version of the hostname, removing trailing dots.
